programme.how_found: web search restricted to korea.ac.kr/korea.edu (discovery only) -> department site; admission data from oia.korea.ac.kr (Admission Guide, Tuition, KU Scholarships) and the Spring 2027 ENG application guide PDF.
programme.notes: Official domains korea.ac.kr and korea.edu (missing from the kb_top100_list row). The international route is the International Undergraduate Admission run by the Office of International Affairs; intakes are Spring and Fall.

english.notes: Korean-taught programme. Spring 2027 guide, '3. Language Proficiency Requirements - Please submit one of the following documents': A. Korean (TOPIK / TOPIK iBT regular test, KU KLC, IEQAS universities, King Sejong intermediate) or 'B. English A score report for TOEFL iBT (including Home Edition / Enhancement) or IELTS Academic' - no minimum score for application; results within 2 years. TOPIK level decides mandatory Korean training (level 5+: none; level 4: one semester). No single minimum to record.

gpa.notes: No GPA minimum published for international freshman applicants; admission by document evaluation (and interview where applicable) per the application guide.

tuition.notes: https://oia.korea.ac.kr/oia2026/Tuition.do: '※ as of 2026 academic year / per semester' - Humanities & Social Sciences Approx. 5,800,000 KRW; Natural Sciences Approx. 6,700,000; Engineering Approx. 7,700,000; Art Approx. 7,800,000. The page does not say which category the College of Informatics (Computer Science and Engineering) falls under, and the figures are approximate, per semester, 2026 academic year - not recorded as a value.

scholarship_exists.quote: Global Leader Scholarship A How to apply All applicants are automatically eligible and therefore there is no separate application required. Evaluation Criteria Admission evaluation Benefits (Freshman) Full tuition fee for 4 semesters
scholarship_exists.notes: FULL_TUITION for 4 semesters (tuition only), awarded on admission evaluation (competitive); renewal needs 12 credits and GPA 3.5 in the previous semester. Also Global Leader B (50% for 4 semesters), Anam Global Scholarship (full tuition for 8 semesters), Bright Futures, KU Global Friends, KU STEM.
